name: PASS Addons – AI & Toolkit for Elementor
author: Productive Minds

sections.description:
Pass Addons is a modular WordPress plugin offering three high-performance modules designed to extend your website’s capabilities: Multi-modal AI Generation, Elementor Toolkit, and Starter Templates. Its modular architecture allows you to activate only the features you need – one, two, or all three, ensuring a tailored experience that scales with your requirements.

The Modules

  • AI-Powered Multimodal Generation Module – Streamline content creation. Generate AI-powered text, images, and videos by integrating your own API keys from leading providers including OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic (Claude), xAI, and Runway.
  • Elementor Addons & Resources Module – Simplify complex designs. Gain access to over 72 functional Elementor widgets to build everything from simple buttons to interactive building blocks and complex pricing tables.
  • Starter Templates Module – Accelerate your workflow. Deploy professionally designed templates, enabling rapid configuration and deployment of your site’s core pages.

🎯 Modular Flexibility: Choose exactly what fits your needs. For example, enable only AI generation and content management tools while keeping other modules disabled.

⭐ Local Data & Full Autonomy

  • Private Local Storage: Your data remains within your WordPress setup. All AI-generated content and media assets are stored locally, ensuring privacy and easy access.
  • Persistent Resource Library: Generate once and keep forever. Manage all saved content, media assets, and corresponding prompts through an integrated library for easy reference.
  • Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK): Maintain full cost control by connecting directly to OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic (Claude), xAI, and Runway using your API keys.
  • Direct Integration: A direct connection between your WordPress and your AI provider – No intermediary servers, processing, or enhancements.

📌 Key Features of the AI Module

  • WordPress Native: Built as a native implementation for stability and performance – no external dependencies.
  • Multi-Provider Support: Gain flexibility by generating text, images, and videos using major provider such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, xAI, and Runway.
  • Flexible API Key Policies: Choose the management style that works for your team:
    • Shared Access: All users share a single API key for each provider.
    • Individual Ownerships: Each user provides their own individual API key for independent usage and cost tracking.
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Maintain security and organization by restricting AI features to specific WordPress roles based on your administrative needs.
  • Localized Content Management: Never lose generated content. Every entry is saved locally along with relevant metadata, allowing you to review, delete, or re-purpose content for site content creation.
  • Media Asset Management: Generate and host images/videos directly on your server. Organize assets by reviewing, deleting or uploading to the media library for workflow integration.
  • Prompt Preservation: Improve repeatable success by saving the exact prompts used to generate every resource, making it easy to reference and iterate on successful results.
  • Reusable Prompt Library (Pro): Maintain a private, local repository of high-performing prompts tailored specifically to your brand’s needs across all generation categories.
  • Export Generated Text (Pro): Download generated content as PDF, Open Document (.odt), HTML, and more – simplifying editing in your favourite word processor.

📌 Key Features of the Elementor Addons Module

  • Access 72+ premium Elementor widgets. Streamline your WordPress development with a comprehensive suite of Elementor widgets and pre-designed templates. Accelerate your workflow without sacrificing granular control over your site’s design.
  • Elementor Widget Examples:
    • Pricing Table
    • FAQs
    • Table of Contents
    • Posts Loop
    • Product Card Carousels
    • Product Elements Grid
    • Team Members
    • Countdown Timer
    • List Item
    • Table of Contents
    • Price List
    • Header Buttons
  • Explore all Elementor Widgets

📌 Key Features of the Starter Templates Module

  • Accelerated Development: Instantly import functional websites for both Elementor and Gutenberg with a single click.
  • Ready-to-Use Templates: Speed up your workflow by launching stunning, pre-configured starter sites that can be customized in minutes.
  • Explore Starter Templates

📌 Plugin Pages

  • Complete plugin description
  • Documentation

📌 Full product details and Free vs Pro comparison

For a complete list of features, visit the plugin’s page here. For an in-depth comparison between the two versions, see the Free vs Pro section.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  • Access your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  • Search for “PASS Addons” in the search bar.
  • Click Install Now, then Activate.
  • Visit Productive… > PASS Addons to configure plugin settings.

► For comprehensive installation guidance, please consult the plugin’s documentation for step-by-step instructions on both manual and automatic installations.

sections.faq:
Can this plugin be used solely as a multimodal AI generation tool?
Yes, each module can be enabled or disabled independently. All modules are equally capable of running concurrently.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, it is compatible with any theme that adheres to standard WordPress development guidelines. However, the starter sites module is specifically optimized to support our WordPress Themes.

How does this plugin facilitate content creation?

The plugin includes specialized post types for various content categories (e.g., Testimonials, FAQs, and Video elements). Once the content is created via these specialized tools, administrators can easily display that data in diverse formats using our Elementor Widgets.

How is starter site data imported into my website?

Note: This only applies while actively importing a starter site (as part of the request). No other data is sent to our servers. When importing a starter site, data is delivered from our server via a secure web service to ensure you always receive the latest version.
* Privacy and security: No authentication details are required. Your homepage URL and admin email are sent to our server only to verify that the request originates from a valid browser/WordPress site and to prevent hotlinking. This information is discarded upon a successful check – it not stored on our servers.
